draft.subject: One next step for Willow Analytics
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Sorry we missed each other on the onboarding call last week. You've already created a project, which is the main thing " in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting the rest of the team in alongside you.

A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever's in the way.

Best,
Chidi
